_comment: mpv binaries bundled next to the agent in release archives, keyed by <goos>/<goarch>. Read by the release workflow's bundle_mpv step (see .github/workflows/release.yml). Windows entries are shinchiro .7z builds (only mpv.exe is extracted). Linux entries are portable 'anylinux' AppImages (need FUSE, or the runtime's built-in extract-and-run fallback on a box without libfuse2 — verify on the target). A target with no entry ships without mpv and the agent falls back to [mpv].binary / PATH. macOS is intentionally omitted: the desktop .app bundles mpv via scripts/build-macos-app.sh, and the darwin service archive uses the system mpv (brew). To bump versions, replace the URLs with a newer release tag from each project; old release assets stay downloadable.
